POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Rohan Joshi | Age: 37
Body Temperature at Scene: 20.7°C | Ambient Temperature: 21.0°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 6.7 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  2. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  3. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  4. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  5. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Benzodiazepines

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
